newsitem.title: UK: Police report two explosions in Belfast.
newsitem.headline: Police report two explosions in Belfast.

text.p: Police in Northern Ireland on Monday said they had received reports of two explosions in Belfast.
The blasts were at a police station in the Short Strand area of the city, police said.
There were no immediate reports of any injuries, police said.
Houses in the area around the Mount Pottinger police station were being evacuated, a police spokesman added.
The latest explosions come as the Irish Republican Army, which is fighting to end British rule in Northern Ireland, has directed a series of attacks against police stations and mobile patrols.

Northern Ireland's police chief, Ronnie Flanagan, said on Sunday that IRA guerrillas appeared determined to kill members of his force in a rapidly escalating 1997 campaign which has raised fears of a return to total sectarian warfare.
